references.text: The parable of the workers in the vineyard reflects the idea of fair reward and God's kingdom, where the last shall be first and the first last.
God's kingdom principles, where God calls those who did not seek him, can be seen as parallel to the workers who were called to work in the vineyard.
God's new covenant with his people, where he writes his laws in their hearts, can be compared to the unexpected and generous reward the workers receive.
